definitions.explanation: The process of something being created, formed, or produced, often used in scientific, technical, or computational contexts.

examples.japanese: AIが{画像|がぞう}を{生成|せいせい}する。
この{化学|かがく}{反応|はんのう}で{水素|すいそ}が{生成|せいせい}される。
examples.english: Hydrogen is produced in this chemical reaction.

examples.japanese: {生成|せいせい}AIの{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{急速|きゅうそく}に{進歩|しんぽ}している。
examples.english: Generative AI technology is advancing rapidly.

notes:
FORMS:
{生|せい} (life, birth) + {成|せい} (become, form) = to come into being.

COMPOUNDS:
- {生成|せいせい}AI: generative AI
- {自動|じどう}{生成|せいせい}: automatic generation
- {画像|がぞう}{生成|せいせい}: image generation
- {文章|ぶんしょう}{生成|せいせい}: text generation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜を{生成|せいせい}する: to generate ~
- 〜が{生成|せいせい}される: ~ is generated/produced
- {生成|せいせい}{過程|かてい}: formation process

USAGE:
{生成|せいせい} has gained widespread everyday use through the term {生成|せいせい}AI (generative AI). In scientific contexts, it refers to the formation of substances through chemical or physical processes. It is more technical than {作成|さくせい} (creation/preparation of documents or materials).
